questions.stem: Which of the following statements is TRUE? The most commonly injured organ in blunt trauma to the abdomen is the liver. The liver is the most commonly injured organ in penetrating abdominal trauma. In gunshot injuries to the abdomen, the stomach is the most commonly injured organ. The jejunum is the most commonly injured part of the bowel in blunt trauma to the abdomen. The mesentery is the most commonly injured structure in seat belt injuries. The first investigation done on a patient with blunt abdominal trauma is a CT scan. CECT is the investigation of choice for a stable patient with blunt abdominal trauma.
